verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's feature-status docs confirm that materialized views (incremental on insert) and refreshable materialized views (scheduled re-computation) are supported. The ingestion docs state that the Kafka table engine and materialized views work as documented, which enables continuous streaming transformations inside the platform. CHKit also lets users deploy pipelines as code. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how MVs and refreshable MVs behave on the separated storage layer, details on CHKit pipeline semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
